bills.title: Customs Amendment (Singapore-Australia Free Trade Agreement Amendment Implementation) Bill 2017

name: The majority voted in favour of the bills' main idea. In parliamentary jargon, they voted to read the bills for a [second time](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html). ### What is the main idea of the bills? The bills make the changes *"necessary as a result of recently agreed changes to the rules of origin in the [Singapore‑Australia Free Trade Agreement](http://dfat.gov.au/trade/agreements/safta/Pages/singapore-australia-fta.aspx) (SAFTA)"*. Read more in the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd1718a/18bd041).
